reviews.title: The RAM I was looking for, worked perfectly!
reviews.comment:
For my Lenovo legion T7 34IAZ7, this RAM worked perfectly on first install with default JEDEC timings/freq. I was able to then boot into BIOS and enable the XMP profile 1 to obtain 5600 MHZ.
Always lookup motherboard QVL list but for me since it was pre built, it wasn't easy to find.
Running 12th gen 12700K with Z690 Mobo.
So happy with this purchase! I went from 32 GB 4800 mhz oem RAM to this 64 GB 5600 MHZ RAM. Couldn't be happier. Also Kingston's website is helpful, it shows all the timings for each XMP profile.

reviews.title: Takes some effort to get it working at advertised speed
reviews.comment: I got this RAM for my new PC build with an i7-13700K processor and Z790 motherboard. Since the 13700K only supports up to 5600MHz memory frequency and this model of RAM is on the QVL for my motherboard, I got this RAM in a 2x32GB kit. Even without overclocking, the memory size makes everything run so efficiently that loading screens in games are practically skipped. Activating the Intel XMP memory overclock, however, was a bit of a pain. Simply activating the preloaded 5600MHz XMP profile prevented my system from loading, prompting my BIOS to revert to its prior settings with XMP disabled. For a while, I had it working by manually setting the RAM speed to 5600MHz and having my BIOS figure out the rest with its AI Overclock feature. Later on, I decided to try fully overclocking my system, instead of just the RAM. Using the AI overclocking program available for my motherboard within the OS, I was able to automatically overclock just about everything in my system. Only after fully overclocking my system was I able to set my RAM (the only feature not overclocked automatically) to its XMP profile without issue. I was expecting that I would be able to overclock the RAM using XMP without changing anything else, but this RAM apparently requires everything else to be overclocked before it will work as advertised. Considering this is one of the most expensive RAM of its speed and size on the market, I was expecting that it would work as advertised without having to jump through hoops, hence the deducted star. I will say, I have not had any issues since I overclocked my system, so this RAM is pretty stable once you successfully set it up.
reviews.author: Jacob N.
